programs.name: Master's Program, Graduate School of International Development (GSID)

deadlines.label: Master's Program AY2027, 2nd round (January exam), application period closes

prerequisites.text: Minimum scores are set for each accepted English proficiency test; applicants below the minimum cannot apply (the scores themselves are not on this HTML page)
prerequisites.quote: We have also set the minimum scores for each English proficiency test. If the score is less than minimum required one, you cannot apply.

prerequisites.text: TOEIC scores are not accepted
prerequisites.quote: TOEIC scores will not be accepted from the entrance examination of 2022.

prerequisites.text: English test scores must come from a test taken within two years of the first day of the application period
prerequisites.quote: New Requirement: Scores will only be accepted from tests taken within two years of the first day of the application period.

prerequisites.text: Admission requires a high level of English proficiency, a basic understanding of the chosen field and logical thinking, assessed by document screening and an oral examination
prerequisites.quote: Document screenings and oral examinations shall be conducted in order to determine whether applicants meet the following requirements: possess a high level of English language proficiency, have a basic understanding of their chosen field of specialization, and are able to think logically.
